title: Session A · Full body
notes: Updated by the coach each week; the weights here are the plan. Every set ends with 2 reps left in the tank. Three pairs: A1 then A2, rest, repeat. Legs moderate: if your back or legs tighten, skip the rest of that exercise.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.note: A1. Up from 35 (12/12/10 last week). Heels down, chest up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.note: A2. Up from 30. One arm, other hand and knee on the bench.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.note: B1. Up from 35. Flat bench. Elbows about 45° from your sides.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.note: B2. Bodyweight. Squeeze at the top for a second.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.note: C1. Up a notch from 20. Seated, bench upright, palms facing each other.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.note: Finisher. Slow. Low back stays flat on the floor.
